title: Recipe for Disaster: Freeing Evil Dave
start: Inspect Evil Dave in the banquet hall in Lumbridge Castle.
prereq_quests: Recipe for Disaster: Another Cook's Quest

items.t: Wily cat, cat, kitten, or lazy cat
Overgrown cats won't work as they do not hunt rats
A kitten is not recommended as the chance of them catching a rat is a low 15% compared to 50% for a normal cat, and will take longer to complete
Up to 10 bowls of stew (If you make no mistakes, you will not need more than 10 bowls. The Forester's Arms sells stew for 20 coins).

recommended.t: Charged amulet of glory or the Wilderness sword for quick teleport to Edgeville. Alternatively, Edgeville lodestone can be used.

rewards.t: The ability to catch hellrats to get a hellcat
The ability to add coloured spices to stew by catching Hellrats (spicy stews can boost or lower certain stats)

steps.t: Inspect Evil Dave inside Lumbridge Castle Banquet Hall.
Optional: West of Edgeville's bank, talk to Doris. [Chat: 1 Is Dave in? › 1 Yes, I'm evil!]
Talk to Evil Dave. [Chat: 2 General chat › 3 What did you eat at the secret council meeting? › 4 You've got to tell me because the magic requires it!]
Speak to Doris, upstairs in the house. If you miss this step, the hellrats will only drop ashes.
Head back in the basement, interact with your cat and select "Chase-Vermin". [Chat: 2 Chase-Vermin](Switch off 'Hide Familiar Options' in Gameplay->Combat & Action Bar-> 'Choose Option' Menu)
As your cat catches the rats, pick up the spices that drop.
p: Your cat has become a hellcat!

steps.t: Do so until at least six doses of each of the four spices are collected.
Make Dave's Evil stew by combining doses of each spice on the stews.
After determining the right combination, have Evil Dave taste it and finish the dialogue. This won't consume the stew.
Head to Lumbridge and give Evil Dave the stew.
